workflows.name: Validate before advancing the application
workflows.statement: Run registered field and page checks before saving; remain with errors if validation fails, using the page error alert. Field answers do not disable Next before submission, except for the applicant's disqualifying membership attestation on the Membership page (membership-attestation-inline-stop).

workflows.name: Save before completing a form page
workflows.statement: Await the configured save before advancing. On a service-signaled technical failure, preserve current answers and redirect to the shared Error page, or Expired access for session expiry. A failed save shows neither a special autosave failure alert nor successful-save feedback. A rejected local simulated save without a service incident retains the current page and shared technical-error wording, permitting retry; this does not add service-failure interception.

workflows.name: Allow an intermediate step before navigation
workflows.statement: An optional page callback can hold navigation after saving and resume it later.

workflows.name: Prevent repeated Next actions during submission
workflows.statement: Disable Next during submission or when the page disables it; show loading during transitions.
